title: LISTEN never receives notifications even though NOTIFY and pg_notify succeed
symptoms: The listener stays silent while pg_notify calls return without error
Notifications arrive late, only after the sending transaction commits
cause: NOTIFY inside a transaction is delivered only at commit, and LISTEN belongs to a single server session, so through a transaction-mode pooler the session that ran LISTEN is handed to other clients. Payloads must be shorter than 8000 bytes by default.
fix: Keep a dedicated direct or session-mode connection for listeners, commit the sending transaction, and send row ids instead of large payloads.
affected: PostgreSQL 13 through 18; Supabase Supavisor transaction mode, as of October 2026; vendor policy, re-check by 2026-12-15
